title: Sailfish Ki Dhasu Speed Ka Sach! 🐟 #shorts
idea: Unveiling how the Sailfish holds the speed record in oceans and uses color-changing stealth to hunt.

lines.text: Samundar ki sabse tez machhli Sailfish ke paas ek anokhi superpower hai!
Ye paani mein sabhi marine animals se zyada tez tairne ka record rakhti hai!
Sirf ek hi saal mein ye machhli 1.5 meter tak badi ho jaati hai!
Shikaar ko confuse karne ke liye ye apna sharir ka rang badal sakti hai!
Attack karte waqt ye apna bada sail pankh upar utha leti hai!
Kya aapko Sailfish ki iss speed ke baare mein pata tha? Comment karo!

facts.claim: Sailfish holds the record for the highest speed of any marine animal.
Sailfish grow quickly to 1.2–1.5 meters in a single year.
Sailfish are capable of changing colors to confuse prey.
